Type the same short phrase on every device. The verses you have recorded are then shared between them.

How to use
  • Each dot is one verse of the King James Bible: 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,102 verses.
  • Tap a book, then tap Record on any chapter to record it verse by verse. Each verse is saved on its own as soon as you tap Stop.
  • A chapter becomes one video when every verse is in. Stitch shows how that is going.
